definitions: Short chains or ribbons attaching a watch to a waistcoat or belt.
Small pockets in a waistcoat or trousers for carrying a watch or other small items.
Pieces of material or tags attached to keyrings, often bearing a logo or design.
examples: He checked his watch on its fob.
She kept her keys on a decorative fob.
The tailor added a fob pocket to the trousers.
